newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN sells Austrian unit to Chrysler.
newsitem.headline: MAN sells Austrian unit to Chrysler.

text.p: German engineering group and truck maker MAN AG said on Wednesday it was selling its Austrian sales unit AC Austro Car to Chrysler International Corporation.
MAN said in a statement that Chrysler, by purchasing Austro Car, will take over its own import and distribution in Austria from June 30.
AC Austro Car has been importing, distributing and servicing Chrysler and Jeep sport utility vehicles since 1988.
It is 100 percent-owned by Oesterreichische Automobilfabrik OEAF-Graef & Stift AG which in turn is a subsidiary of MAN.
Austro car's sales in its 1996/1997 business year totalled an estimated 280 million marks ($162.4 million).
The company is market leader for limousines and large cross-country vehicles in Austria with respective market shares of 20 percent and 31 percent.
Some 30,000 Chrysler and Jeep vehicles are registered in Austria.
